implementation_summary: auditStoreRoutes (list, get, remove) and auditShortlistRoutes (getShortlist, putShortlist, listShortlist) factories returning Route rows whose method, path and access come from AUDIT_API. Deps: store, caller(ctx) -> {owner, helperEmail?}, optional isRunning. Helper filtering and per-audit permission checks (view/edit) happen in the handlers; remove is owner-only and 409 while running; invalid input is 400 ERR_INVALID_REQUEST with a field message; store failures map to fixed sentences with no internals.

risks: New AuditRouteDeps.caller seam: RouteContext has no caller identity, so BE-190 must supply owner/helperEmail.
BE-190 should pass isRunning from the run slot (kind 'audit' and the running audit id); otherwise a stale 'running' status after a crash blocks deletion.
Rows declare no beta policy, so a beta copy refuses them (closed by default, D-004).
GET shortlist for an audit with no entry returns an empty entry with updatedAt ''.
Edits are read from the version file named 'edits', the same name audit-documents.ts uses.
Store failures answer 500 with { error } and no code, matching the audit-documents.ts precedent, because AuditErrorCode has no store-unavailable code.
